employee_of_the_month.name: Mira
employee_of_the_month.reason: Cut the sleep current of the sensor node by a large margin, so the battery now lasts far longer between charges.
employee_of_the_month.reason_de: Hat den Ruhestrom des Sensorknotens stark gesenkt, sodass der Akku jetzt deutlich länger hält.

current_project.name: Plant monitor v3
current_project.summary: Sensor stake, app and firmware are working together. We are now testing battery life and the waterproof enclosure.
current_project.next: Field test on a real plant for two weeks
current_project.summary_de: Sensorstab, App und Firmware arbeiten zusammen. Wir testen gerade Akkulaufzeit und das wasserdichte Gehäuse.
current_project.next_de: Feldtest an einer echten Pflanze, zwei Wochen

highlights.title: New board revision
highlights.text: The sensor board was redrawn to fit the new enclosure outline.
